record.paper_title: Categorical Torelli theorems: results and open problems
record.original_question: Let F: D1 -> D2 be an exact equivalence between admissible subcategories D1 and D2 of Db(X1) and Db(X2), respectively, with X1 and X2 smooth projective over a field K. Does there necessarily exist a Fourier-Mukai equivalence D1 ~= D2?

evidence.quote: Is there a Fourier– Mukai equivalence

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $K$ be a field and let $X_1, X_2$ be smooth projective varieties over $K$. Denote by $D^b(X_i) := D^b(\mathrm{Coh}(X_i))$ the bounded derived category of coherent sheaves on $X_i$. A full triangulated subcategory $\mathcal{D}_i \subset D^b(X_i)$ is called admissible if its inclusion functor admits both a left and a right adjoint. An exact equivalence $F: \mathcal{D}_1 \to \mathcal{D}_2$ between such admissible subcategories is said to be of Fourier–Mukai type if there exists an object $\mathcal{E} \in D^b(X_1 \times_K X_2)$ such that $F$ is isomorphic to the restriction to $\mathcal{D}_1$ of the functor $\Phi_{\mathcal{E}}(-) := R p_{2*}(p_1^* (-) \otimes^{L} \mathcal{E}) : D^b(X_1) \to D^b(X_2)$, with image landing in $\mathcal{D}_2$, where $p_1, p_2$ are the projections from $X_1 \times_K X_2$.

Question: Given any exact equivalence $F: \mathcal{D}_1 \to \mathcal{D}_2$ between admissible subcategories of $D^b(X_1)$ and $D^b(X_2)$ respectively, must there exist a Fourier–Mukai equivalence $\mathcal{D}_1 \simeq \mathcal{D}_2$ (i.e., an equivalence between $\mathcal{D}_1$ and $\mathcal{D}_2$ of Fourier–Mukai type)?
artifact.status_search_result: This is widely regarded as an open problem. Orlov's 1996 representability theorem covers fully faithful exact functors between full derived categories $D^b(X_1) \to D^b(X_2)$ (with adjoints), but the analogous statement for equivalences between admissible subcategories—such as Kuznetsov components—remains open in general. Recent surveys and works (Canonaco–Stellari; categorical Torelli surveys) state the FM-representability for admissible subcategories as an open question, with only partial results in special geometric situations.

status_evidence.title: Fourier–Mukai Functors: A Survey
status_evidence.snippet: When is an exact functor between derived categories of smooth projective varieties of Fourier–Mukai type?
status_evidence.claim: FM-representability of equivalences (especially for admissible subcategories) is highlighted as an open question.

status_evidence.title: Categorical Torelli theorems: results and open problems
status_evidence.snippet: Question on whether an exact equivalence of admissible subcategories is necessarily a Fourier–Mukai equivalence.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is stated as an open question in the categorical Torelli survey.
